subject: Run linux embedded build on Ubuntu 24.04 (#4140)
summary: Changes the linux embedded build matrix in .github/workflows/cpp_server_build_test_release.yml from ubuntu-latest to ubuntu-24.04 in two places (the X86_64 linux artifact job and the linux-embeddable build job) to match advertised Ubuntu 24.04 support and fix glibc 2.43 incompatibility on Ubuntu 24.04 hosts.
